fields.description: Binghatti Etherea places studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments above a retail and podium base in Jumeirah Village Circle. The shared leisure deck combines swimming, outdoor movement and quieter seating areas. Apartment layouts differ substantially in balcony provision, so the selected type matters as much as its bedroom count.

overview: The brochure lists 282 residences and 5 ground-floor retail shops. Its structure is basement,ground,five podium and 22 residential levels,plus mechanical and roof levels.
The published plans include both compact and extensive balcony arrangements. Saleable totals include outdoor components and should not be read as interior-only space.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. The developer identifies access to Al Khail Road and E311. Verify the exact building approach and selected-home outlook before relying on marketing travel times.
research.priceNote: The own page displays AED 764999. Property Finder retains AED 786999 as a launch reference. These differently maintained guides do not verify current stock, a unit quotation or a reservation right.
research.paymentNote: The developer FAQ states 20%booking,50%during construction and 30%on completion. The retrieved Property Finder header instead shows 50/50, while its FAQ mixes incompatible percentages. The primary published split is retained; no exact instalment dates or signed offer were retrieved.
research.handoverNote: Binghatti’s own FAQ gives July 2027. Property Finder shows December 2027. No later primary dated construction or completion document was retrieved to reconcile these estimates; obtain the contracted date and current developer update.
